notes: Arabic RTL word-search game (app name جُمَل). All questions, words and the 3x4 letter grid are the repo's real level 1 data; found/selected cells follow the coded rules (orthogonal adjacency, 10 points per letter, 3 stars under 60 s). Sample data is only the timer values and the progress state (levels 1-2 done, level 3 current, 210 points, 3 hints). Things the owner should know: (1) Font: the theme asks for 'Cairo' but pubspec.yaml bundles no fonts, so the real app renders in the system font - drawn with SF Arabic, not Cairo. (2) Success dialog: unlike the hint/exit dialogs it has no Material ancestor, so in a real build its texts (مبروك!, the stat rows) would most likely show Flutter's yellow double-underline fallback style; drawn clean, as designed. (3) Level data: with the coded orthogonal-only adjacency, levels 3 and 4 (and at least one word in each of levels 5-9) cannot be traced in their grids, so a real player cannot get past level 3 - that is why the map is drawn at level 3 of 14. (4) Animated values (pulse, float, confetti phase) are frozen at one frame; confetti positions use the painter's own formula.
